methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: In this code we use a linear regression model to predict the remaining lifespan of a fuel cell/battery system, based on the input data collected.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Proposes a fuel-cell/battery monitoring and energy-flow optimization framework plus a linear-regression model predicting component remaining life (RUL); no EnPI/EnB energy-performance measurement model is presented or characterised (no energy baseline, EnPI, SEC, or ISO 50001/50006).

paper_type.evidence_quote: present a system that monitors in real time the performance of a hybrid fuel cell/battery system

stage1.notes: Title/abstract say 'energy performance monitoring' but substantively this is condition monitoring + RUL prognostics + energy-flow optimization for FC/battery hybrids (EV/marine). Only fitted model targets remaining life, not energy. Terminological overlap flagged for human check.
